title: Toggl
description: Restructured product, design and engineering teams at a profitable SaaS company, cutting costs by 26% while increasing output implementing an AI based user inights and prototyping flow. Drove a 94% increase in first-time activation by removing friction from the early user journey.

sections.title: Context
sections.body: Toggl is a profitable, bootstrapped SaaS company with a mature time-tracking product used by individuals and teams like Meta globally. As Head of Product since January 2026, I own the product strategy, roadmap, and team structure across product, design, and engineering.

sections.title: Problem
sections.body: After 20 years of growing the team, product and design teams were not as focused on customer inisghts and feedback as needed. Going from a multi product portfolio to an integrated one product strategy and the possibilities to use AI automated work on user inisghts collection, design and prototyping we reviewed the possibilities to restructure the team to align more witrh this new way of working. With bringing simple task focused tools into one unified product, the first-time activation of the new product was low, meaning users who signed up were not reaching the point where the product demonstrated an increased value to them compared to the existing product in their first visit.

sections.title: My role
sections.body: I own the product strategy and team structure end-to-end. Togher with the CTO the structure, roles, implementtion plan and training plan to use AI in design, user insights collection, prototyping and development was defined and agreed with the leadership team.. and defined the activation improvement programme, and introduced the AI-assisted prototyping and insight process. Execution is delegated across the product, design, and engineering teams.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: I diagnosed the activation problem through funnel analysis and user research, identifying friction in the early user journey as the primary drop-off driver. I restructured the product, design, and engineering teams to remove redundant overhead, consolidate responsibilities, and improve delivery speed. In parallel, I introduced AI-powered prototyping and user insight collection tools, compressing the cycle from insight to validated solution from weeks to days.

sections.title: Outcome
sections.body:
• First-time activation increased 94%
  • Team costs reduced 26% through restructuring
  • Team output increased 13%
  • Insight-to-validated-solution cycle reduced from weeks to days
